items.question: What exactly is a digital consultation?
items.answer: A digital consultation is a structured review of your online business presence. We review your website, checkout process, trust signals, and overall digital setup, then provide clear written recommendations tailored to your business.

items.question: What does a website audit include?
items.answer: A website audit includes a full review of your website design, user experience, page speed, trust signals, checkout clarity, and content. You receive a detailed written report with specific, prioritized recommendations.

items.question: Can you build my website from scratch?
items.answer: Yes. The Elite Launch Package includes a complete website design and build. For other packages, we provide consultation and recommendations. You can then implement them yourself or contact us for a custom implementation quote.

items.question: What industries do you work with?
items.answer: We work with founders and small businesses across various industries including retail, services, freelancing, and e-commerce. Our consultation approach is adapted to each business type and goal.

items.question: How does the process work?
items.answer: Our process has four steps: Discover (structured consultation to understand your business), Diagnose (review and identify what needs improvement), Build or Improve (design, develop, or deliver the audit report), and Deliver (final delivery with guidance on next steps).

items.question: How long does a consultation take?
items.answer: Consultation length depends on the package selected. Packages range from 30 minutes for the Starter to 90 minutes for the Advanced package. The Elite Launch Package includes full website design and build, which typically takes 5 to 10 business days.

items.question: How do I receive my consultation report?
items.answer: Your written consultation report is delivered via email within the timeframe specified for your package. We typically respond within 24 to 48 business hours.

items.question: What is included in the Elite Launch Package?
items.answer: The Elite Launch Package includes complete website design and build, e-commerce or landing page setup, full UI/UX and trust signal review, payment-readiness preparation, and priority support for 30 days after delivery.

items.question: Are there any hidden fees?
items.answer: No. All package prices are clearly listed. There are no hidden fees or surprise charges. If you need services beyond what a package includes, we will provide a clear quote before any additional work begins.

items.question: Do you guarantee Stripe or PayPal approval?
items.answer: No. DegiScaler LLC does not guarantee approval from Stripe, PayPal, or any other payment processor or financial institution. We help improve your website's professionalism, clarity, and trust signals. Final payment processing decisions are made by the payment processors themselves.

items.question: Do you offer refunds?
items.answer: Digital consultation services are non-refundable once the consultation session has been conducted or the report has been delivered. If the service has not yet been initiated, you may request a cancellation within 24 hours of purchase. Please review our full Refund Policy for details.

We do not collect payment card information directly — all payments are processed through third-party payment processors.

These third parties have their own privacy policies and we recommend reviewing them. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of third-party payment processors or service providers.

sections.content: Our website may use cookies to improve your browsing experience. You can control cookie settings through your browser preferences. Disabling cookies may affect some functionality of our website.

sections.title: Your Rights
sections.content: You have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal information. To exercise these rights, please contact us at support@degiscaler.com.

sections.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of significant changes by posting the updated policy on our website. Continued use of our services after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
